reason: Code inspection establishes that W is the rank of the explicit active exclusion from the native polarization, not a numerical truncation of the polarization. Increasing W at fixed N removes response channels without adding their CI configurations. The original independent W convergence criterion conflated a change of downfolding partition with numerical convergence. Its failed sensitivity checks are retained, not relabelled as passed.
fixed_Hamiltonian_check: Two consecutive N increments at fixed W=16; full configuration space retained in each window.
coherent_model_check: Two consecutive N increments with W=N, so the native polarization excludes precisely the canonical frontier represented in CI, plus the unchanged optimized ROKS target sectors.
screening_numerical_check: Positive dielectric and three independent quadratic-form checks of the reused native/bath update, relative error below 1e-9.
optical_tracking: Metric principal angles of roots 2 and 3, with all root intensities and native-target coverage reported.
scope: Post-exposure development test of the fixed rank-two model; no experimental accuracy, blind validation or pigment nuclear-derivative claim. Do not claim robustness to inconsistent exclusion/CI partitions.
